title: Restore the doctrine tokens the operating-block rewrite dropped
action: Cell vd-10 rewrote the shipped operating block for the merged gate and the new evidence rule, and dropped several unrelated required tokens on the way out. test_gate_bypass_doctrine.mjs is red on packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md only. Run the suite and DERIVE the full missing set from its own assertions; known examples, not the list: the briefing fan-out wording ('standard: on-demand' / 'high-risk: always'), the docs/history tree note's 'plan.md is opt-in' and 'cell is the micro-plan', and critical rule 8's D3/D4 tie ('whether or not the lane produced a plan.md (D3/D4)'). Restore each where it belongs semantically -- inside the line that carries the rule -- not as a keyword appended to satisfy a grep. Constraints from scripts/tests/test_agents_budget.mjs: rules stay contiguous with no gaps, the rule-count constant must match reality, TERMINAL_HOME rules keep full text rather than a pointer, and the byte fence is 15000 hard / 14000 warn on both the template and the rendered root AGENTS.md (it is near 13.3K now, so there is room but not unlimited room). Never hand-edit root AGENTS.md -- edit the template and re-render via node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply.
